# MJDT Global (明杰供应链)

> MJDT Global, trading as 明杰供应链 (Mingjie Supply Chain), is a Shenzhen-based cross-border logistics and freight forwarding company. It moves commercial cargo and e-commerce orders from China to more than 50 countries, with scheduled lanes to Bangladesh, Israel, Australia, Africa and South Africa, and door-to-door DDP delivery into Europe. Services cover procurement, consolidation, air and sea freight, customs clearance, overseas warehousing and drop shipping.

Contact: seaairking@163.com | Website: https://www.mjdtglobal.com | Chinese site: https://www.mjdtglobal.com/ | English site: https://www.mjdtglobal.com/en/

## Company facts

- Legal and trading name: MJDT Global / 明杰供应链 (Mingjie Supply Chain)
- Base: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- Business: international freight forwarding, cross-border e-commerce logistics, overseas warehousing, procurement and consolidation
- Coverage: 50+ destination countries; scheduled lanes to Bangladesh, Israel, Australia, South Africa and the wider African continent, and the European Union
- Service models: port-to-port, door-to-door, DDP (delivered duty paid), DDU, LCL consolidation, FCL, air freight, rail freight, overseas warehouse drop shipping
- Languages: Chinese, English
- Contact: seaairking@163.com

## Core service lines

- **Europe DDP & EU customs clearance**: European door-to-door DDP: consolidated customs entry, duty and VAT settlement, ICS2 ENS filing, CBAM, CE/GPSR product compliance, packaging EPR/PPWR, returns.
- **China to Israel**: Air and sea freight to Israel, DDP e-commerce, SII and Ministry approvals, Ashdod and Haifa handling, customs documents, last-mile pickup networks, in-country stock.
- **China to Bangladesh**: Chattogram sea freight, Dhaka air freight, DDP parcels, EPZ and bonded inputs, RMG supply chain, COD last mile, project cargo, import documents and PSI.
- **China to Australia**: Air and sea freight, Amazon AU FBA and GST, LCL consolidation, DAFF biosecurity, last-mile 3PL, returns, oversize goods, port selection, schedule reliability.
- **China to Africa & South Africa**: SARS clearance, Durban and Coega, OR Tambo air freight, West Africa LCL, Egypt and ACID, landlocked SADC transit corridors.
- **Overseas warehouse & drop shipping**: Warehouse node selection, inbound receiving, replenishment, pick and pack, cycle counting, value-added services, WMS integration and multi-platform fulfilment.

## Editorial notes

- All guides are written by the MJDT Global logistics team and dated; each page shows its publication month in the URL slug and in the article metadata.
- Freight rates and transit times are quoted per shipment. The site deliberately publishes ranges and operational constraints rather than fixed prices, and points readers to request a quote for current numbers.
- Content is descriptive and regulatory in nature. It is not legal or tax advice.
